description: Rongide piiriületused is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet. The source of the data to be published is the Border Control Database (PIKO). The purpose of the establishment of the border control database is to ensure internal security and public order through the processing of data collected by persons and means of transport upon crossing the border. Coverage: Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet. The portal shows the English title as "Train crossings" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet. Its keywords include reisirongid, carriage of goods, kaubarongid, locomotives, riigipiirid, police. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
